verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same two formulas, written with the Lean's names. The prefactor matches exactly: ChartScales.timeCoefficient h n = T_g^{nativeIndex h n} · Q n^{1+h} is the paper's c_{i_0} = T_g^{i_0}Q^{1+h} (p. 95), and chartPrefactor is its inverse; temporalInverse is the real part of the (8.19) inverse applied to the centered (zero auxiliary mean) source, i.e. N_{i_0}^{-1}E^∘. temporalAtIndex instantiates the angular case (thetaResidual, giving Δv) and temporalPotential the axial case (axialResidual, giving γ_d). The third clause is chartPrefactor_bound, with the constant made explicit as C = T_g and S_* as ChartScales.S n = n²; it carries the extra hypotheses 0 ≤ h and 4 ≤ n. The restriction to bands n ≥ 4 is recovered for all bands by chartPrefactor_bandBound_all (TemporalMeanUpdate.lean:323), which gives the same band bound with constant T_g + ∑_{i<4} chartPrefactor h i whenever ChartScales.S n ≤ s.slow n; so the clause 'c_{i_0}^{-1} ≲ S_*' holds unrestricted at the cost of a larger constant.
